# Third-party provenance

* SAGA: <https://github.com/gsiros/saga>, commit `7372111bea150e32cee390a616849316d2780bfc`. The exact author-source ZIP and its per-file hash manifest are retained under `experiments/rq2_v2/`. Apache-2.0 license: `SAGA-LICENSE` and the archive's own `LICENSE`. No author Python file was rewritten for packaging. The adapter adjusts runtime addresses/configuration and business orchestration; it does not claim GReDAC's recursive security properties for native SAGA.
* A2A: <https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-python>, SDK 1.3.0 (reference commit `0d9dafb92328144384eca58a6e8ab80cb8f7d445`); protocol reference 1.0.1 at <https://github.com/a2aproject/A2A> (`3303592588e388e62e0f69f701af531d2f4e3991`). Install the external SDK using the integration lock file; its source/wheels are not vendored. SAGA A2A was consulted at commit `e60590a9ee7275a3fce5896259bb654752513f31` on its `a2a` branch.
* RTT data: RIPE Atlas public measurements, <https://atlas.ripe.net/>. The frozen `samples.json` retains original source/path identifiers and sample values. See [RIPE Atlas terms](https://www.ripe.net/about-us/legal/ripe-atlas-service-terms-and-conditions/). No new license is asserted over the measurements. Raw API metadata downloads are omitted; the original pool SHA256 is recorded in provenance.
* Cryptography, Flask/MongoDB client, plotting packages, Z3, Tamarin and Maude are installed separately and retain their own terms. No virtual environment, solver executable, MongoDB executable or generated secret material is distributed here.
